nodes.title: Pointwise averages on the modular homogeneous space
nodes.statement: Let G=SL(2, real), Γ=SL(2, integer) embedded entrywise, X=G/Γ with its quotient Borel structure, μ the normalized G-invariant Haar probability, a_t=diag(exp t, exp(-t)), and S(gΓ)=a_1 gΓ. For every μ-integrable real f, native Birkhoff averages of S converge μ-almost everywhere to ∫f dμ.
hypotheses: All domain, measure, sign and indexing hypotheses are explicit in the statement.
proofSteps: Import the concrete quotient, lattice, normalized measure and left-action contract requested from GN.4.

The subgroup {a_t:t∈real} is closed and noncompact; to conclude time-one ergodicity use the stronger GN.4 Howe–Moore mixing restriction, since continuous-flow ergodicity alone does not imply time-one ergodicity.
Apply the inherited pointwise ergodic theorem to S and f.
acceptance: This is Haar-almost-everywhere on X. It makes no assertion about every point u_xΓ or Lebesgue-almost-everywhere on a single horocycle.

hypotheses: All domain, measure, sign and indexing hypotheses are explicit in the statement.
proofSteps: Import the requested DT.0 equivalence between bounded native continued-fraction digits and badly approximable numbers, with irrationality retained.
Use the two explicit short-vector estimates and GN.4 Mahler compactness to obtain the diagonal-semiorbit criterion.
Translate the source’s row-vector Γ\G convention by transpose and double its time parameter.
acceptance: The rational x=0 has the short vector (0,exp(-t)) and an unbounded orbit; irrationality is essential.

nodes.title: Finite greedy orbit coloring
nodes.statement: For σ:natural→natural, M≥1 and N, construct a list of triples (start,length,isBlue). Starting at k=0, while k<N: if 1≤σ(k)≤M and k+σ(k)≤N, append the blue block (k,σ(k),true) and advance; if σ(k)=0 or σ(k)>M, append the red singleton (k,1,false) and advance; otherwise stop, leaving a terminal interval. The list is ordered by start and covers an initial segment of {0,…,N−1}.
hypotheses: All domain, measure, sign and indexing hypotheses are explicit in the statement.
proofSteps: Use recursion with fuel N, since every appended block advances by at least one.
The only early stop is a positive permitted block that would overrun N.
